t: What Does The Name Jabou Mean?
s: In Senegambia and Guinea-Bissau, Jabou often appears as a diminutive or affectionate variant of names linked to Arabic Jābi/Jābir or to localized forms of names borne by revered women in the community, evolving through sound shifts and baby-talk forms into Jabou, Jabbou, or Diabou (French-influenced orthography).
